records.literal_gloss: And it will be for you as [a] tassel, and you will see it and remember all [the] commandments of Yahweh and do them, and not you will go about after your heart and after your eyes, after which you [are] prostituting,

en.L: 'And it shall be a tassel for you, and you shall look at it and remember all the commandments of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} and do them, and you shall not go about after your heart and after your eyes, after which you prostitute yourselves,
en.B: 'Whenever you see this tassel, it will remind you of all the commandments of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, so that you do them and do not wander after your own heart and your own eyes, following them in unfaithfulness,
en.R: 'When you look at the tassel, you will remember all {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}'s commands and obey them. You will not just follow whatever your heart wants and your eyes see. Following them is like being unfaithful in a marriage.

es.L: “Y será para {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} una borla, y la {{plural_you:mirarán|miraréis}} y {{plural_you:se acordarán|os acordaréis}} de todos los mandamientos {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} y los {{plural_you:cumplirán|cumpliréis}}, y no {{plural_you:andarán|andaréis}} explorando tras {{plural_you:su|vuestro}} corazón y tras {{plural_you:sus|vuestros}} ojos, tras los cuales {{plural_you:se prostituyen|os prostituís}},
es.B: “Cada vez que {{plural_you:vean|veáis}} esta borla, {{plural_you:les|os}} recordará todos los mandamientos {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, para que los {{plural_you:cumplan|cumpláis}} y no {{plural_you:anden|andéis}} errantes tras {{plural_you:su|vuestro}} propio corazón y {{plural_you:sus|vuestros}} propios ojos, siguiéndolos con infidelidad,
es.R: “Cuando {{plural_you:miren|miréis}} la borla, {{plural_you:se acordarán|os acordaréis}} de todos los mandatos {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} y los {{plural_you:obedecerán|obedeceréis}}. No {{plural_you:seguirán|seguiréis}} simplemente lo que {{plural_you:su|vuestro}} corazón quiera y lo que {{plural_you:sus|vuestros}} ojos vean. Seguir eso es como ser infiel en un matrimonio.

fr.L: “Et ce sera pour vous une houppe, et vous la regarderez et vous vous souviendrez de tous les commandements {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} et vous les pratiquerez, et vous n’irez pas explorer à la suite de votre cœur et à la suite de vos yeux, derrière lesquels vous vous prostituez,
fr.B: “Chaque fois que vous verrez cette houppe, elle vous rappellera tous les commandements {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, pour que vous les mettiez en pratique et que vous n’erriez pas au gré de votre propre cœur et de vos propres yeux, en les suivant dans l’infidélité,
fr.R: “Quand vous regarderez la houppe, vous vous souviendrez de tous les commandements {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} et vous y obéirez. Vous ne suivrez pas simplement ce que votre cœur désire et ce que vos yeux voient. Les suivre, c’est comme être infidèle dans un mariage.

sw.L: 'Nacho kitakuwa kishada kwenu, nanyi mtakitazama na kuzikumbuka amri zote za {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} na kuzitenda, wala hamtazunguka kufuata moyo wenu na macho yenu, ambayo ninyi mnafanya ukahaba kwa kuyafuata,
sw.B: 'Kila mtakapokiona kishada hiki, kitawakumbusha amri zote za {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, ili mzitende na msitangetange kufuata moyo wenu wenyewe na macho yenu wenyewe, mkiyafuata kwa ukosefu wa uaminifu,
sw.R: 'Mtakapokitazama kishada, mtazikumbuka amri zote za {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} na kuzitii. Hamtafuata tu chochote mioyo yenu inachotaka na macho yenu yanachoona. Kufuata hayo ni kama kutokuwa mwaminifu katika ndoa.

vi.L: 'Và đó sẽ là cái tua cho các ngươi, và các ngươi sẽ nhìn nó và nhớ lại tất cả các điều răn của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} và làm theo, và các ngươi sẽ không đi lang thang theo lòng mình và theo mắt mình, là những điều các ngươi theo đó mà gian dâm,
vi.B: 'Mỗi khi các ngươi thấy cái tua này, nó sẽ nhắc các ngươi nhớ mọi điều răn của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, để các ngươi làm theo, và không đi lang thang theo lòng mình và mắt mình, chạy theo chúng mà bất trung,
vi.R: 'Khi nhìn cái tua, các ngươi sẽ nhớ tất cả các điều răn của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} và vâng giữ. Các ngươi sẽ không chạy theo bất cứ điều gì lòng mình muốn và mắt mình thấy. Chạy theo những điều ấy giống như không chung thủy trong hôn nhân.

ko.L: '그리고 그것이 너희에게 술이 될 것이니, 너희는 그것을 보고 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 모든 계명을 기억하여 그것들을 행하고, 너희가 음행하며 따르는 너희 마음과 너희 눈을 따라 두루 다니지 말라.
ko.B: '너희는 이 술을 볼 때마다 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 모든 계명을 기억하고 그것을 지켜라. 너희 마음과 너희 눈이 끄는 대로 따라다니며 신실하지 못한 길로 가지 말라.
ko.R: '너희는 그 술을 볼 때마다 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 모든 명령을 기억하고 지켜라. 너희 마음이 원하는 대로, 너희 눈에 보기 좋은 대로 따라가지 말라. 그것을 따르는 것은 남편이나 아내를 배신하는 것과 같다.

pt.L: 'E isso será para vocês uma borla, e vocês a verão e se lembrarão de todos os mandamentos {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} e os cumprirão, e não andarão atrás do coração de vocês e atrás dos olhos de vocês, atrás dos quais vocês se prostituem,
pt.B: 'Sempre que virem esta borla, ela fará vocês se lembrarem de todos os mandamentos {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}, para que os cumpram e não andem atrás do próprio coração e dos próprios olhos, seguindo-os em infidelidade,
pt.R: 'Quando olharem para a borla, vocês vão se lembrar de todos os mandamentos {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} e vão obedecer a eles. Vocês não vão simplesmente seguir o que o coração de vocês deseja e o que os olhos de vocês veem. Seguir essas coisas é como ser infiel no casamento.

am.L: “ዘርፍ ይሆንላችኋል፤ ታዩታላችሁ፤ {{divine_name:የእግዚአብሔርን|የያህዌን}} ትእዛዛት ሁሉ ታስባላችሁ፤ ታደርጓቸዋላችሁም፤ ተከትላችኋቸው ዝሙት የምትፈጽሙባቸውን ልባችሁንና ዓይናችሁን ተከትላችሁ አትዞሩም፤
am.B: “ይህን ዘርፍ ባያችሁ ቁጥር {{divine_name:የእግዚአብሔርን|የያህዌን}} ትእዛዛት ሁሉ ታስታውሳላችሁ፤ ይህም ትእዛዛቱን እንድትፈጽሙ፣ ታማኝነትን አጥታችሁ የገዛ ልባችሁንና የገዛ ዓይናችሁን ተከትላችሁ እንዳትቅበዘበዙ ነው፤
am.R: “ዘርፉን ስትመለከቱ {{divine_name:የእግዚአብሔርን|የያህዌን}} ትእዛዛት ሁሉ ታስታውሳላችሁ፤ ትታዘዟቸዋላችሁም። ልባችሁ የሚመኘውንና ዓይናችሁ የሚያየውን ሁሉ ዝም ብላችሁ አትከተሉም። እነርሱን መከተል በትዳር ውስጥ ታማኝ አለመሆን ነው።

decisions.choice: go about: the word used of the spies
decisions.reason: The verb means to go about exploring or searching out. It is the word used for the spies who went to scout the land (13:2, 16-17; 14:34). Israel had followed what the spies saw rather than what the LORD said; the tassel is to keep them from following their own eyes.

decisions.choice: after your heart and after your eyes: your own desires and what attracts you
decisions.reason: The heart is the seat of thought and will, and the eyes the way desire is drawn to things. To go after them is to be led by one's own wishes instead of God's commands.

decisions.choice: prostituting: unfaithfulness to God
decisions.reason: Israel's turning from the LORD is often pictured as sexual unfaithfulness (Exodus 34:15-16; Judges 2:17). The noun from the same verb is used of the people's unfaithfulness in 14:33.

decisions.choice: it shall be a tassel for you: the tassel with its blue cord
decisions.reason: "It" is the tassel the LORD has just described; seeing it is meant to bring the commands to mind. The sentence runs on into verse 40.

decisions.choice: like being unfaithful in a marriage
decisions.reason: Readable explains the picture behind the word instead of reproducing it. Balanced says "in unfaithfulness"; Literal keeps "prostitute yourselves".

decisions.choice: "gian dâm" (L); "bất trung" (B); "không chung thủy trong hôn nhân" (R)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the picture of prostitution, Balanced says it is unfaithfulness to God (meaning decision), and Readable explains the comparison, as the English Readable does; the same choice as 14:33.

decisions.choice: "đi lang thang" for go about
decisions.reason: The verb is the one used of the scouts (meaning decision); Vietnamese cannot keep the echo of "do thám" without losing the sense of roaming after one's desires.

decisions.choice: "두루 다니다" (L)
decisions.reason: The same verb as the scouts' "spy out" (meaning decision); Literal uses the "두루 다니다" that the scouts' report in 13:32 and 14:7 also uses, so the echo is heard.

decisions.choice: "음행하며" (L); "신실하지 못한 길" (B); "배신하는 것과 같다" (R)
decisions.reason: As in 14:33: unfaithfulness to God pictured as prostitution (meaning decision); Literal keeps the picture, Balanced says what it means, and Readable compares it to unfaithfulness in marriage, as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: andarão atrás de (L)
decisions.reason: The verb is the "espiar" of chapters 13-14 (m1). Portuguese cannot say "espiar atrás do coração", so Literal says "andar atrás de", as the English Literal says "go about after", and the link to the spies is left to the meaning note.

decisions.choice: "ዝሙት የምትፈጽሙባቸውን" (after which you commit whoredom) at Literal
decisions.reason: As at 14:33, Literal keeps the Hebrew picture; Balanced and Readable say what it means, unfaithfulness to God.

ko.L: 그리하여 너희가 내 모든 계명을 기억하고 행하여, 너희 하나님께 거룩하게 될 것이다.

pt.L: para que vocês se lembrem e cumpram todos os {{deity_pronoun:meus|Meus}} mandamentos, e sejam santos para o Deus de vocês.
pt.B: para que vocês se lembrem de todos os {{deity_pronoun:meus|Meus}} mandamentos e os cumpram, e sejam santos para o Deus de vocês.

decisions.choice: holy to your God: set apart for God and belonging to him
decisions.reason: To be holy is to belong to God and to share his character (Leviticus 11:44; 19:2). Here the whole people, not only the priests, are called to be holy by keeping his commands.

decisions.choice: my commandments: the LORD speaks of himself
decisions.reason: Verse 39 spoke of "the commandments of the LORD"; here the LORD calls them his own, and verse 41 names him.

decisions.choice: set apart for
decisions.reason: Readable adds "set apart for" to say what being holy to God means.

decisions.choice: who brought you out of Egypt to be your God: the ground of the commands
decisions.reason: The LORD's rescue of Israel from Egypt is the reason they are to obey him; he freed them so that they would belong to him as their God (Exodus 6:7; 20:2; Leviticus 11:45).

decisions.choice: I am the LORD your God, repeated: a closing seal
decisions.reason: The words open and close the verse, framing the law and the chapter with the LORD's own name.
